name: anonymize__csv
title: Anonymize CSV
description:
Anonymize CSV: Replace cells and headers in CSV, selected by column name or number, driven by a rule set. Returns the anonymized document. Rules that match nothing and literals that survive are reported; the tool does not find sensitive data by itself.
Outputs: result (text).

text.title: CSV
text.description: The CSV document to anonymize. Required: give the text here or a file path in textFile.

rules.title: Rule set (JSON)
rules.description: Rules that say what to find (literal, property, path, regex, column) and what to do with it (mask, fixed, pseudonym, hash, remove). Required: give the text here or a file path in rulesFile.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Secret that keys pseudonyms and hashes. The same seed gives the same output; keep it private, it is not saved in rule sets. An empty or short seed makes guessing easy.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Field separator of the input; the output keeps it.

customDelimiter.title: Custom delimiter
customDelimiter.description: The separator when delimiter is custom: one character that is not a quote or a line break.

header.title: First record is a header
header.description: Column names can be used in rules only when this is on.

escapeFormulas.title: Escape formulas
escapeFormulas.description: Prefix ' to values written by a rule that start with =, +, -, @, tab or CR so a spreadsheet does not run them. Cells the rules did not change are never altered.

trailingNewline.title: Trailing newline
trailingNewline.description: End the last record with a line break.

bom.title: Byte order mark
bom.description: Write a UTF-8 byte order mark first.

textFile.title: CSV (file)
textFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "text": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

rulesFile.title: Rule set (JSON) (file)
rulesFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "rules": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

name: compare__csv
title: Compare CSV
description:
Compare CSV: Compare 2 to 20 CSV documents with a base. The first record is the header; rows can be matched by key columns. Returns a summary table (one row per compared document) and a table of the differences (document, change, path, base value, value); cells compare as text unless inferTypes is on.
Outputs: summary (table as CSV), changes (table as CSV); sidebyside (unified diff) only with includeDiff.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Two to twenty documents; every one is compared with the base. Required: give the texts here or file paths in documentsFiles.

names.title: Names
names.description: Optional labels, one per document. Give the texts here or file paths in namesFiles.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Compare the values, or only the keys and the value types.

base.title: Base document
base.description: Which document is the reference; every other document is compared with it.

key.title: Match by key
key.description: Match array items (and CSV rows) by these fields instead of by position: id or id, sku. Items must carry every field as a plain value.

ignoreOrder.title: Ignore order
ignoreOrder.description: Treat arrays without a key as sets: the same items in another order are equal.

ignorePaths.title: Ignore paths
ignorePaths.description: Dot paths to leave out, one per line (or separated by ;): items.price, catalog.book.@id. Array positions are skipped.

numbers.title: Compare numbers
numbers.description: text: 10.50 and 10.5 differ (marked as the same value); value: numbers that are equal as decimals are equal, and in XML and CSV number-like text counts as a number.

maxDiffs.title: Most differences
maxDiffs.description: Most differences listed per document; all are still counted.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Field separator; auto detects it for each document.

customDelimiter.title: Custom delimiter
customDelimiter.description: The separator when delimiter is custom: one character that is not a quote or a line break.

inferTypes.title: Infer types
inferTypes.description: Read true, false and number text as booleans and numbers instead of strings.

documentsFiles.title: Documents (files)
documentsFiles.description: Paths of files to read (read-only) instead of "documents", one document per file.

namesFiles.title: Names (files)
namesFiles.description: Paths of files to read (read-only) instead of "names", one document per file.

includeDiff.title: Include diff
includeDiff.description: Also return a unified diff of the two documents as printed.

name: datetime__convert
title: Convert date patterns
description:
Convert date patterns: Convert patterns between C# and Java; every token that does not render identically is flagged with the reason. Returns a table with one row per pattern: the converted pattern, whether it round-trips, and the flags.
Outputs: table (table as CSV).

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: Patterns in the source language, one per line. Blank lines are skipped; at most 200 patterns of 1000 characters. Required: give the text here or a file path in patternsFile.

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: Optional: render both patterns at this instant to see the difference. ISO 8601 with an offset. Give the text here or a file path in instantFile.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which language the patterns are written in.

patternsFile.title: Patterns (file)
patternsFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "patterns": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

instantFile.title: Instant (file)
instantFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "instant": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

name: datetime__csharp
title: C# date format
description:
C# date format: Render an instant with C# standard and custom format strings under InvariantCulture, as .NET does. Returns a table with one row per format string and its rendering.
Outputs: table (table as CSV).

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: ISO 8601 with an offset, for example 2024-03-05T14:07:09.1203456+05:30 or ...Z. Named time zones are not supported. Required: give the text here or a file path in instantFile.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: C# format strings (an empty text renders the default ToString() format), one per line. Blank lines are skipped; at most 200 patterns of 1000 characters. Required: give the text here or a file path in patternsFile.

valueKind.title: Value kind
valueKind.description: offset is a DateTimeOffset (the format U throws); utc is a UTC DateTime (K prints Z, U works).

instantFile.title: Instant (file)
instantFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "instant": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

patternsFile.title: Patterns (file)
patternsFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "patterns": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

name: datetime__java
title: Java date format
description:
Java date format: Render an instant with Java DateTimeFormatter patterns for Locale.US, with JDK 8 behaviour. Returns a table with one row per pattern and its rendering.
Outputs: table (table as CSV).

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: ISO 8601 with an offset, for example 2024-03-05T14:07:09.1203456+05:30 or ...Z. Named time zones are not supported. Required: give the text here or a file path in instantFile.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: Java DateTimeFormatter patterns, one per line. Blank lines are skipped; at most 200 patterns of 1000 characters. Required: give the text here or a file path in patternsFile.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: offset keeps the offset of the instant (a ZoneOffset); UTC converts it to the UTC region.

instantFile.title: Instant (file)
instantFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "instant": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

patternsFile.title: Patterns (file)
patternsFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "patterns": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

description:
Date format reference: Search every C# and Java date-time specifier; the example column is rendered by the real formatter at a fixed instant. Returns a table with one row per specifier.
Outputs: table (table as CSV).

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Text to find in any column, ignoring case. It is matched literally, not as a pattern. Give the text here or a file path in filterFile.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Only the specifiers of one language.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: standard and custom are C#; letter is Java; syntax covers quotes, escapes, optional sections and padding.

filterFile.title: Filter (file)
filterFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "filter": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

name: encoding__base64
title: Base64 (text and objects)
description:
Base64 (text and objects): Encode text, JSON or XML to Base64, or decode Base64 back (strict, standard or URL-safe alphabet). Returns the encoded text, or the decoded text (formatted when source is json or xml); bytes that are not UTF-8 text are an error or a hex view.
Outputs: result (text).

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to encode, or the Base64 text to decode. Required: give the text here or a file path in textFile.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: encode turns the input into the encoded form; decode turns it back.

source.title: Source
source.description: json and xml are parsed first: encode writes them minified, decode formats them.

variant.title: Alphabet
variant.description: standard uses + and /, url uses - and _ (RFC 4648 section 5).

lineLength.title: Line length
lineLength.description: Wrap the encoded text at this width (0 = one line, 76 = MIME).

indent.title: Indent
indent.description: Decode with source json or xml: indent of the formatted result, 2 or 4 spaces, a tab, or none for one line.

binary.title: Binary result
binary.description: What decode does when the bytes are not UTF-8 text: report an error or show a hex view.

textFile.title: Text (file)
textFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "text": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.

title: Base64 (file)
description:
Base64 (file): Encode a file to Base64 text, or decode a file that holds Base64 (binary safe). Returns the Base64 text, or the decoded text; decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 text are a hex view or an error.
Outputs: result (text).

file.title: File
file.description: The file to encode, or the file holding the Base64 text to decode. Path of a file to read (read-only).

lineLength.description: Wrap the encoded text at this width (0 = one line, 76 = MIME).

binary.title: Binary result
binary.description: What decode does when the bytes are not UTF-8 text: show a hex view or report an error.

name: encoding__jwt
title: JWT decoder (no verification)
description:
JWT decoder (no verification): Decode the header and payload of a JWT and show its dates. The signature is never verified. Returns the header and the payload as JSON and a table of the claims with their dates and status; the status of exp and nbf is judged against the current time, so it can change from one call to the next.
Outputs: header (text), payload (text), claims (table as CSV).

text.description: The JWT: three Base64url parts separated by dots. Required: give the text here or a file path in textFile.

indent.title: Indent
indent.description: Indent of the JSON shown: 2 or 4 spaces, a tab, or none for one line.

name: encoding__timestamp
title: Unix timestamp
description:
Unix timestamp: Convert epoch seconds or milliseconds to dates, ISO 8601 text to epoch values, or print the current time. Returns a table with one row per value; mode now gives the current time, which changes from one call to the next.

from.description: Unit of the number when the text has none, for example km. The text wins when both are given.

significantDigits.title: Significant digits
significantDigits.description: Digits shown in the result (1 to 40), rounded half away from zero; trailing zeros are dropped.

notation.title: Notation
notation.description: auto writes plain digits for 0.000001 up to below 1e15 and scientific notation outside that range.

textFile.title: Quantity (file)
textFile.description: Path of a file to read (read-only) instead of "text": UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark.
